gate_linkage: This fixture is the eval GATE for HERMES_QUANT_CATALYST_ONBOARDING. ADR-0075 stays *Proposed* and the flag stays OFF until run_admission_precision over this set is GREEN at the stated bar. The flag-flip is an OPERATOR action; this fixture does not flip it.
return_capture: Realized forward returns are signed % moves over the packet horizon, captured ONCE offline and committed (NOT live in-test). The LUNR/RKLB/ASTS Blue-Origin moves reuse the same documented returns as the catalyst directional-precision fixture (test_catalyst.py::test_precision_blue_origin_case).

episodes.label: LUNR Blue-Origin New Glenn explosion (ADR-0075 seed episode)
episodes.provenance: The original ADR-0075 motivating case. Blue Origin New Glenn explodes; out-of-universe space-launch reactor LUNR (Intuitive Machines) moves bearishly. Out-of-universe, fresh, strong, tradeable -> admitted; realized move down matches the bearish stance -> HIT.

episodes.label: RKLB Blue-Origin explosion contagion
episodes.provenance: Rocket Lab, sector peer in the same launch-failure basket. Out-of-universe on the day, admitted; realized down move matches bearish -> HIT.

episodes.label: ASTS Blue-Origin explosion contagion
episodes.provenance: AST SpaceMobile, the sharpest space-launch reactor in the basket. Out-of-universe, admitted; large realized down move matches bearish -> HIT.

episodes.label: LCID EV demand catalyst
episodes.provenance: Lucid, a documented out-of-universe high-beta EV reactor. A bullish demand catalyst is admitted; realized up move matches bullish -> HIT.

episodes.label: SPR aero-supplier catalyst (documented MISS)
episodes.provenance: Spirit AeroSystems. A bullish supplier catalyst that was admitted but FADED -- the realized move went the OTHER way. This is the DOCUMENTED false positive that keeps the set honest (the bar must be cleared WITH a miss in the denominator, not by cherry-picking only winners).

episodes.label: PLUG sub-threshold confidence (NEGATIVE CONTROL: below tau_conf)
episodes.provenance: NEGATIVE CONTROL. A weak (confidence 0.55 < tau_conf 0.60) out-of-universe packet that happens to be directionally WRONG (admitted-stance bullish vs realized -9.5%). Onboarding would NOT admit it, so it must be EXCLUDED from scoring -- if the gate leaked it through it would TANK the rate. Proves a benign/weak admission does not get scored as a hit OR a miss.

episodes.label: JOBY sub-threshold magnitude (NEGATIVE CONTROL: below tau_mag)
episodes.provenance: NEGATIVE CONTROL. High confidence but magnitude 0.02 < tau_mag 0.04 -> a low-severity catalyst onboarding deliberately does NOT act on. It happens to be directionally CORRECT (+7.3% vs bullish), so if the gate leaked it through it would INFLATE precision with a free hit. Proves a benign correct-but-weak admission does not pad the hit-rate.

episodes.label: AMD transient screen artifact (NEGATIVE CONTROL: in-universe)
episodes.provenance: NEGATIVE CONTROL. AMD is the ADR-0075 'transient screen artifact' -- already in the daily universe, so it is NOT a catalyst admission (the advisor already recommends it). Strong packet, but in_universe=true -> not admitted, must not be scored. It is directionally WRONG (bullish vs -1.2%), so leaking it would TANK the rate.

episodes.label: SOFI tradeability fail-closed (NEGATIVE CONTROL: not tradeable)
episodes.provenance: NEGATIVE CONTROL. A strong out-of-universe bearish packet whose broker tradeability gate FAILS (tradeable=false: e.g. no borrow / unfillable). Admission must not create an unfillable order -> rejected. It is directionally CORRECT (-5% vs bearish), so leaking it would INFLATE the hit-rate with a name we could never have traded.

episodes.label: RIVN neutral stance (NEGATIVE CONTROL: no direction)
episodes.provenance: NEGATIVE CONTROL. A neutral-stance packet has no tradeable direction (onboarding derives direction from stance; neutral -> dropped). Not admitted, not scored, regardless of the realized move.
